summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of NORDPEP bilingual peptides e-commerce. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (meta, products, auth/register/login/me, checkout interac+QC tax, nowpayments mock, compliance enforcement, orders mine, admin RBAC, order status update, product CRUD). Frontend: age gate, EN/FR toggle, catalog (12 products), add-to-cart, cart drawer with subtotal, checkout flow with QC tax 14.975%, Interac order confirmation showing orders@nordpep.ca and NP- order number, admin login + dashboard tabs (orders/products/customers) and stats all functional.

ui_bugs.issue: CART label visually overlaps with the 'cart-count-badge' (badge sits on top of CART text). Minor design glitch when count > 0.

Sonner 'Added to cart' toast (z-index) intercepts pointer events on cart-checkout-btn for a few seconds after adding an item. Playwright click was blocked until the toast disappeared. Real users with mouse will likely be fine but the overlay z-order is fragile.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by dev tagging instrumentation injecting <span> inside <option> elements. Cosmetic warning only; functionality unaffected.

action_items: Optional: tighten cart badge positioning so it doesn't overlap the CART label visually.
Optional: lower the z-index of Sonner toasts below the cart drawer, or shorten toast duration on the catalog page, to avoid the checkout button being intercepted right after adding an item.
Optional: investigate the hydration warning regarding <span> inside <option> on Checkout.jsx (likely Emergent dev tooling, harmless in prod build).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: app.add_middleware uses allow_credentials=False while set_auth_cookie sets SameSite=None secure cookies. Cookies will be set but cannot be read on cross-origin XHRs; the frontend correctly relies on Bearer token in Authorization header so this is fine, but if you ever want cookie-based auth from FE you'll need allow_credentials=True + explicit origins.

Anonymous checkout (no auth) is allowed — order is created with user_id=None and is retrievable by anyone with the order_id. Documented behavior in /api/orders/{order_id} (anonymous orders visible if order_id known). Acceptable for guest checkout but worth flagging.
JWT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env — must be rotated before production.
PROVINCE_TAX default fallback is 0.05 if province key unknown — silent fallback. Consider raising 400 for invalid province codes.
No rate limiting / brute force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentioned ≥5 fail lockout requirement). Currently any number of wrong attempts return 401 with no throttling.
test_credentials: Admin admin@nordpep.ca / NordpepAdmin2026! works as expected (seeded on startup). Newly registered users via /api/auth/register work fine.
seed_data_creation: 12 peptide products auto-seeded by backend startup (SEED_PRODUCTS). Test created a few TEST_ orders and a TEST_ product (deleted at end of CRUD test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_nordpep_api.py covers all 15 critical scenarios. Frontend cart drawer auto-opens on add-to-cart (CartContext.add calls setOpen(true)). When using Playwright, wait ~4s after add-to-cart for the Sonner toast to clear before clicking cart-checkout-btn, OR use JS click via page.evaluate. Login redirects admins to /account not /admin — must navigate to /admin manually. All data-testids match the spec in the request.
